audit_scope: Read-only extraction of aggregate results, stored protocols and source code. No image decoding, model inference, retraining or bootstrap recomputation in this evidence audit.

feature_and_model_definitions.calibrated_margin: m_j = raw_fake_logit_j/T for single-logit detectors; m_j=(z_fake_j-z_real_j)/T for EfficientNetV2-M
full_nine_features: fraction of transformed predictions that differ from the original
feature_and_model_definitions.resize_ablation_caution: Three views and SIX features, not a three-feature selector: confidence + two oriented changes + three summaries recomputed only from retained views.
feature_and_model_definitions.class_prediction: unchanged by every selector; lower score accepted first
feature_and_model_definitions.profile_preprocessing: RGB; JPEG subsampling 0, optimize false; round scale dimensions with min 1; LANCZOS down-and-restore before detector-native preprocessing
feature_and_model_definitions.training_public_detectors: Separate train-only weighted StandardScaler and error-target LogisticRegression per detector, C=0.1, lbfgs, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-9; weights sum to one per source group; 40000 augmented profiles from 5000 origins; T fitted on separate 1000 clean detector-calibration inputs; no external refit.

native_preprocessing.clip: RGB -> CenterCrop(224), no Resize -> tensor -> CLIP mean/std; raw 768-d image embedding to frozen Linear(768,1), no L2 feature normalization.
native_preprocessing.resnet50: RGB -> CenterCrop(224), no Resize -> tensor -> ImageNet mean/std; author ResNet-50 one-logit Blur+JPEG probability0.5 checkpoint.
native_preprocessing.efficientnet_v2_m: RGB -> Resize shorter edge563, BICUBIC -> CenterCrop512 -> tensor -> ImageNet mean/std; two natural logits, original decision in FP32.

feature_and_model_definitions.dropout_wording: MC dropout was evaluated only on the EfficientNetV2-M checkpoint native trained classifier dropouts. The pinned CLIP and ResNet-50 models were evaluated deterministically; no stochastic layers were introduced. This is a scope/architecture decision, not a general impossibility claim about those architecture families.
feature_and_model_definitions.single_logit_energy_wording: Only native two-logit EfficientNet energy was evaluated. Constructing an artificial pair from a binary margin is not the same native energy because a common logit shift changes energy while preserving probabilities.

retrospective_source_cohorts.scope: Nové, bez skóre vybrané obrázky známych verejných zdrojov. Zdroje boli vybrané po exploratívnej analýze predchádzajúcich výsledkov. OpenFake: DOCCI a päť generátorov vrátane Illustrious ako kontrolného zdroja. DeepShield: nové obrázky už známych domén a rodín, s vopred určenou zmesou. Toto je nezávislosť nových vzoriek od evidovaných dát, nie zdrojovo nezávislá validácia. Pomer tried a kvóty nereprezentujú prevádzkovú početnosť. Skryté identity, promptové a predtréningové prieniky nemožno úplne vylúčiť. Hodnotí detektor a selektor, nie celú multimodálnu aplikáciu. Rozsah bol z výpočtových dôvodov zmenšený pred vyhodnotením nových výsledkov; OpenFake má 4 000 obrázkov a obe kohorty iba clean. Historické výsledky nie sú ďalšími novými pozorovaniami.

limitations_and_claim_boundaries: Do not pool development, retrospective and independent external results or call all of them confirmatory.
CLIP/ResNet test different pretrained checkpoints and native preprocessing; this is evidence of transfer across detectors, not a controlled causal isolation of architecture.
Relative AURC improvement does not imply improved detector accuracy or acceptable absolute accepted risk; CLIP/RN external detector accuracies are often near or below 0.5.
Public-detector primary hypothesis is only lr_full versus confidence on OpenFake for both detectors. Other datasets and ablations have descriptive pointwise intervals.
No CI for lr_full versus lr_confidence was computed in the public-detector experiment; their direct comparison in this evidence is point-estimate only.
MC/energy intervals are descriptive and conditional on fixed trained models and one realization of masks. K=6 is a prefix of the same draws, not a separate independent run.
Bahat seed43 has significantly lower descriptive AURC than the full profile on retrospective OpenFake; report all seeds rather than choosing a winner.
The ablation confirmation retains full under the locked rule. This is not proof that full is superior to resize: resize improves OpenFake AURC, while matched-risk superiority was not established.

Ablation OpenFake has43 connected groups and a3412-image component (56.8667%); severe imbalance limits bootstrap precision. DeepShield has only one discordant matched-error group and fails the ten-group adequacy guard.
DeepShield confirmation mixture differs from earlier10000: real FFHQ/FORLAB20/80 vs30/70; fake GAN/diffusion30/70 vs54/46.

Historical pHash missingness remains:295682 available out of554181 CSV rows,258499 missing. These are inventory rows, not unique images. Raw/RGB and known provenance are audited but hidden semantics/person/pretraining overlaps are not excluded.

For the newest confirmation, disjointness covers accepted origins and previously accessed sampling blocks; a newly accessed block may contain unselected historic identities. No universal disjointness of all history-connected components is claimed.
Fixed-coverage SHA tie namespaces differ across experiment families; old report tie counts need not be bitwise identical. Blockwise AURC definitions are preserved.

Timings have different scope; MC uses one cached deterministic backbone and30 stochastic head calls, not30 full backbones. The ablation run extracted all six views jointly and did not measure an optimized three-view deployment runtime.
No transfer of any prior selective-risk guarantee under external distribution shift; no external threshold tuning, no external training, and no automatic model or thesis modification.
